question: Ignorando mayúsculas, puntuación y formas societarias como Inc., LLC o Corp., ¿cuántos proveedores (UEI distintos) tienen el mismo nombre que una empresa u organización de la Lista Consolidada de Control, o que uno de sus alias?

attempts.query:
WITH csl_names AS (
  SELECT e.name AS n FROM csl.entry e WHERE e.type = 'Entity'
  UNION
  SELECT a FROM csl.entry e, unnest(e.alt_names) a WHERE e.type = 'Entity'
),
norm_csl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(' ' || regexp_replace(lower(n), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g') || ' ', '( (inc|incorporated|llc|l l c|corp|corporation|co|company|ltd|limited|plc|lp|llp|l p|sa|s a|gmbh|ag|pllc|pc|the))+(?= )', ' ', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS k
  FROM csl_names WHERE n IS NOT NULL
),
norm_rec AS (
  SELECT r.uei, trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(' ' || regexp_replace(lower(r.name), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g') || ' ', '( (inc|incorporated|llc|l l c|corp|corporation|co|company|ltd|limited|plc|lp|llp|l p|sa|s a|gmbh|ag|pllc|pc|the))+(?= )', ' ', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS k
  FROM usaspending.recipient r WHERE r.uei IS NOT NULL AND r.name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nr.uei) FROM norm_rec nr JOIN norm_csl nc ON nc.k = nr.k WHERE nr.k <> ''
